articles.title_en: Putin is reportedly open to Article 5-style security guarantees for Ukraine. But what does Article 5 actually say? Would the guarantees require NATO members to go to war if Russia attacks again?
articles.lead_en: Sources close to the U.S. negotiating team led by Donald Trump’s special envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner said a ceasefire or a peace deal to end Russia’s war against Ukraine could include security guarantees for Kyiv modeled on Article 5 of NATO’s founding treaty, or even full NATO membership for Ukraine.

articles.title_en: At least 720,000 Russian soldiers killed in Ukraine by fall 2026, Meduza and Mediazona estimate in new analysis that includes missing troops for the first time
articles.lead_en: At least 720,000 Russian armed forces personnel had died in the war in Ukraine by fall 2026, according to a new analysis by Meduza and Mediazona.

articles.title_en: Western intelligence services say Russia could put satellite with nuclear warhead into orbit in coming months
articles.lead_en: Russia may put a satellite carrying a nuclear explosive device into orbit, Western intelligence services and military officials believe, including the Bundeswehr (Germany’s armed forces) and Germany’s Federal Intelligence Service. Representatives of several NATO countries recently exchanged information on the matter, the German outlets WDR, NDR, and Süddeutsche Zeitung reported.
